selection_disclosure: V2 established that executable economics cannot be inferred from title algebra alone. V3 was specified after that audit. Every V1/V2 observation is excluded from V3 evidence, including all previously positive parser errors.
hypothesis: Content-addressed venue rules plus a finite-state payoff proof can identify rare same-venue bundles whose minimum terminal payout exceeds synchronized executable asks after two times current fees, subject to displayed capacity and explicit non-atomic orphan risk.

certification.rule_document: Exact event and market settlement metadata is persisted once under a SHA-256 content hash.
certification.candidate_identity: Universe version, legs, payoff proof and rule-certification hash; any rule change creates a new candidate.
accepted: non-augmented explicit negRisk complete event sets
same-scope sports total and spread ladders with identical normalized rule templates
fail_closed: dates, margins and percentages presented as price ladders
unknown rules, fee schedules, venue minimums or payoff states
certification.state_oracle: Enumerated certified terminal states; exactly-one sets use the closed-form state list. Unsupported general components above 12 predicates require a future SAT/MILP oracle and fail closed.

execution.book_model: walk every displayed ask level for every leg
execution.fees: current per-market fee metadata stressed at 2x; unknown schedules fail closed
execution.minimum_size: maximum published venue minimum across legs
execution.promotion_rule: No multi-leg bundle is labelled qualified until a separate execution study demonstrates bounded orphan risk.

evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across relation class, latency profile and inspected capacity band
evaluation.null_outcome: No executable certified bundle is an acceptable result.
